newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures ends lower as weather concerns ease.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures ends lower as weather concerns ease.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled lower in late selling after fears over cold weather hitting Florida's citrus belt eased, traders and analysts said.
A floor source said late speculative selling reversed the day's gains.
Juice made gains Friday on fears of a cold weather front which initially was thought to threaten the citrus region late this week or during the following weeks.
Most active March orange juice settled 1.05 cents weaker at 94.95 cents per pound. Spot January went out 1.00 cent lower at 91.40 cents.
"It looks like the cold front is supposed to be affecting areas outside the citrus belt so that accounted for the down day," said Bernard Savaiko of PaineWebber.
The losses were a disappointment for the speculative longs after the firm start to trading. "This could be a portent of lower prices unless we get a frost," Savaiko added.
